title: Apple Maps Adopts ‘Lake America’ Label, Following Google
dek: Apple has updated its map labels after a federal naming change, illustrating how geographic data platforms are adapting their products by market and jurisdiction.
socialCaption: Apple Maps has joined Google in using “Lake America” for Lake Ontario in the US after a federal naming update. The Canadian app retains “Lake Ontario,” while international versions show both—a reminder that map data is increasingly localized by jurisdiction.
